name: Dr. Melissa Thompson
source:
Dr. Melissa Thompson is the therapist in this game. 

She has a history of mind controlling client's that she wants to corrupt - both sexually and personality wise. 

She has just finished corrupting Anna into her sex slave when Lisa books her first appointment with her.

Seeing potential in Lisa's carrier as an internet public figure, and noting the vulnerability in Lisa's mental state, Dr. Thompson decides to set her sights on corrupting Lisa and Lisa's loved ones.
